title: HTTP/3 RFC 9114 Positive Floor Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, HTTP/3 frame and stream tests, SETTINGS and header-validation tests, minimal client/server loopback tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for the HTTP/3 positive floor.
scope: This verification covers the HTTP/3 positive floor: frame parsing and writing, stream classification, control-stream sequencing, SETTINGS exchange, header validation, and the minimal client/server request-response path. It does not verify interop matrix promotion or external peer behavior.
preconditions: The repo remains in the JSON-only SpecTrace workflow.
The HTTP/3 package stays independent from ASP.NET hosting concerns.
expected_result: The focused HTTP/3 tests pass, the requirement-home tests confirm trace linkage for the HTTP/3 positive floor, core SpecTrace JSON validation accepts the new artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The managed HTTP/3 positive floor is trace-owned by canonical RFC 9114 artifacts and is covered by focused frame, stream, SETTINGS, header-validation, and loopback client/server tests. External peer promotion remains a separate interop concern.
